besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two full clauses.
besluite.rede: Two clauses with their own subject and verb (fluitjie klink / trom klink), so the AWS 2017 comma is required.

besluite.rede: Two clauses with their own subjects (jy kan slaan / sy klank bly), so the comma is required; nothing else changes.

The possessive 'hulle xilofone' carries that these are the Chopi's own instruments, set against the school marimba just before; dropping it loses that and the original reads acceptably.

besluite.fout: 'Dek die hele pad' is an unidiomatic calque of 'cover the whole range'.
besluite.rede: 'Die hele reeks van hoog tot laag' is the natural Afrikaans and says exactly the same, in a word a Grade 4 reader knows.

besluite.fout: 'Hoort laag' is not natural Afrikaans, and an intransitive 'vel span oor' is stiff.
besluite.rede: 'Is oor 'n wye opening gespan en hoort aan die lae kant' is natural and keeps the same place on the high-low line; no fact added.

besluite.fout: 'Hierdie drie' follows a list of four instruments, so the reader cannot tell which three are meant.
besluite.rede: 'Die laaste drie' fixes the reference to the hosho, kokonratels and bottle, which is the only reading consistent with the ngoma being placed low.

besluite.fout: 'Dra hoog en laag' is wooden and vague.
besluite.rede: 'Het hoë en lae klanke binne een instrument' says the same plainly for a Grade 4 reader.

besluite.fout: Imperative 'Hoor watter...' right after 'Luister na' reads oddly as an instruction to notice.
besluite.rede: 'Let op watter instrumente' is the natural instruction in a listening task and keeps the meaning.
'Karakters bou' (building up a character) is accepted drama usage in Afrikaans and may echo the curriculum's wording; 'skep' narrows developing to creating, a lateral move at best.

besluite.fout: 'En steeds anders klink' copies English 'and still sound different'.
besluite.rede: 'En tog anders klink' is the natural Afrikaans concessive and carries the same contrast.

besluite.fout: Read alone, the glossary entry 'al klink dit ewe hoog en hard' has no comparison point.
besluite.rede: A real fault in a glossary definition, but the fix adds a comparison ('as 'n ander instrument'), so the writer must reword it.

besluite.fout: 'Wat jou gesig wys van dit wat jy voel' is wooden.
besluite.rede: A real fault in a glossary definition, but 'Hoe jou gesig wys' shifts the term from what the face shows to how it shows it, so the writer must fix it.
The ruggraat definition is protected word for word as a shared definition, and 'loop' for something running along the back is ordinary Afrikaans.
